limitations: Browser timing is RAF observation, including frame scheduling/software GPU stalls; it is not the exact damage-execution timestamp.
Authority/transport/snapshot delivery can add online wall time; no simulated client damage.
Software renderer frame measurements do not certify player FPS.

visualReview.scope: Response timing and camera impulse; existing VFX art unchanged
findings: Full VFX releases and damage feedback remain present after the short cast.
Camera impulses are stronger for Lv80/90, recover without drift, and remain disabled with reduced motion.
Lv100 shake duration is exactly 1.5 times the previous configured duration.
RAF-observed feedback on software renderer can exceed200ms and is not represented as actual simulation execution time.
